title: Open Mic @ Mulligan's Pub
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring all genres of live music from folk to rock. One of Eugene's oldest and most established open mic nights.
event_venue_information:
Mulligan's Pub - Historic Open Mic Venue

Mulligan's Pub is an iconic Irish pub and dive bar located in Eugene that has hosted one of the city's longest-running open mic nights. The venue features a cozy stage in the back and has developed a reputation as a proving ground for local musicians. The pub is known for its devoted music community and friendly atmosphere. Every Tuesday night musicians gather for open mic performances featuring diverse genres including rock, blues, folk and original compositions. The pub serves local craft beer and offers a happy hour with $3 drafts between 4-6 PM on weekdays.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Beergarden
event_description: Monday night open bluegrass jam featuring acoustic string instruments. All skill levels welcome to play or listen. Hosted by musicians from the Belltower band.
event_venue_information:
Beergarden - Community Beer Garden and Jam Venue

Beergarden is a family-friendly beer garden featuring 42 taps of craft beer cider and mead plus rotating food trucks. The venue hosts regular bluegrass jam sessions on Monday nights with an open jam format. The outdoor beer garden includes fire pits and games making it a welcoming community space. In addition to bluegrass jams the venue hosts live music performances throughout the week and board games are available free to play. The atmosphere is casual and all ages are welcome until 10 PM nightly.

title: Open Mic @ PublicHouse Springfield
event_description: Weekly open mic hosted by local legend Amblin featuring all forms of musical expression. Musicians provide their own instruments while Amblin handles sound equipment.
event_venue_information:
PublicHouse - Community Gathering Space and Music Venue

PublicHouse is located in a restored historic church building in downtown Springfield and serves as a major community hub. The venue features a beer hall whiskey lab outdoor arbor bar and rotating food vendors. Live music and entertainment events are hosted regularly with a focus on all-ages family-friendly performances. The open mic on Sundays is hosted by Amblin a well-known Eugene musician who runs open mics throughout the region. The outdoor lawn area provides excellent space for acoustic performances. PublicHouse also hosts bands and musicians from the bluegrass folk and Americana traditions.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Gratitude Brewing
event_description: Rotating Wednesday night bluegrass jam sessions hosted by Corwin Bolt and friends. Musicians of all skill levels welcome to participate with acoustic instruments.
event_venue_information:
Gratitude Brewing - Downtown Brewery and Music Venue

Gratitude Brewing is a family-friendly craft brewery located in the historic Old Foundry building in downtown Eugene. The brewery features a scratch kitchen with rotating food specials and 20 taps of house-made craft beers. Regular live music and jam sessions are hosted throughout the week making it a center for Eugene's acoustic music community. The bluegrass jam sessions rotate between Gratitude and Oakshire Commons in Springfield. The venue welcomes all ages and skill levels to participate in jam sessions and enjoy live performances. Board games are available for patrons and the atmosphere is welcoming and supportive of local musicians.

title: Altered Reality Open Mic @ Alluvium
event_description: Open mic for musicians playing for musicians in a supportive community atmosphere. All forms of musical expression welcome. No pressure to perform.
event_venue_information:
Alluvium Church - Community Music Venue

Alluvium Church located in Eugene's Whitaker neighborhood hosts Altered Reality a weekly open mic for musicians. The venue is dedicated to supporting the local music community and the unhoused population in the neighborhood. The open mic focuses on musicians playing for musicians in a supportive and welcoming atmosphere. All ages welcome. The space provides a safe community environment for musical expression and experimentation. Entry is through the south door under the MLK mural.

title: Spoken Word Open Mic @ John Henry's
event_description: Monthly spoken word open mic featuring poetry prose short fiction and storytelling. All forms of wordcraft welcome.
event_venue_information:
John Henry's - Music Bar and Venue

John Henry's is an intimate downtown music venue and bar that re-established in 2022. Located at 881 Willamette Street the venue features excellent sound system and a friendly bar serving Oregon craft beer and cocktails. John Henry's hosts diverse live music performances including rock punk hip-hop indie and singer-songwriter acts. The venue also hosts monthly spoken word open mics comedy shows burlesque performances and DJ dance parties. The standing room layout puts audiences close to the stage for an immersive experience. Many shows are 21-plus unless noted. The atmosphere celebrates beer music and art.
